description.en:
Places a flipper reserved with CMND_BTL_REG_FLIPPER on the pitch and switches it on.

The flipper's entry in the pitch-object table receives the position (X and Z, height 0) and is marked active.
The optional rotation and direction vector are handled differently: they are not stored in the flipper's entry but appended to a separate list, in call order. The first call that passes a rotation fills the first slot of that list, the second call the second slot, and so on. The pinball map places its flippers in handle order, so the two line up.
Rotation around the vertical axis. Passing it appends a new entry to the flipper list.
2-element direction vector stored with that list entry. Only read when rotY is also given.

true once the flipper is placed.
null if the match system is not ready or fewer than 3 arguments were given.

examples.case: Placing the flippers in the four corners (real usage, from mf14b01.nut)
Moving an existing flipper without touching its rotation
examples.code:
// Position only: no new rotation entry is appended
CMND_BTL_ACTIVE_FLIPPER(hFlipper[0], 100, 200);
